sanskrit:
एवं बहुविधा यज्ञा वितता ब्रह्मणो मुखे।
कर्मजान्विद्धि तान्सर्वानेवं ज्ञात्वा विमोक्ष्यसे।।
image_english: All these different sacrifices are approved by the Vedas, and all are born of different types of work.
caption:
Chapter 4, Verse 32

Kṛṣṇa summarizes the variety of sacrifices. ‘evaṁ bahu-vidhā yajñā vitatā brahmaṇo mukhe’ (All these different types of sacrifice are approved by the Vedas). ‘karma-jān viddhi tān sarvān’ (Know them all to be born of different types of work). Whether it is physical yoga, mental study, or monetary charity, all involve action. The soul is not inert. ‘evaṁ jñātvā vimokṣyase’ (Knowing this, you will be liberated). The key is not to stop working, but to choose the type of ‘Yajña’ (work) that suits your nature and perform it as an offering. This turns the ‘struggle for existence’ into the ‘joy of service’.
